name: Barkeep Daniels
summary: At the Lakeshire Inn, Barkeep Daniels keeps drinks flowing while raiders trouble the roads. Town guards, fishermen, and travelers find welcome there, though supplies are running low.

sections.title: Keeping Spirits High in Lakeshire
sections.body: Near the bridge, Barkeep Daniels pours drinks and greets visitors at the Lakeshire Inn. Gnolls and Blackrock orcs have pressured Lakeshire for months, and its defenders turn to the tavern after grim patrols. Raids and severed roads have disrupted trade across the region. With liquor running low when the town needs good cheer, Daniels welcomes travelers willing to fetch shipments from safer settlements.

faq.answer: Barkeep Daniels tends the counter at the Lakeshire Inn and serves townsfolk, travelers, and the town guard.

faq.q: Why is he running low on drinks?
faq.answer: Blackrock orc and gnoll raids have choked off caravans and trade routes into the Redridge Mountains. Deliveries have stopped, while stressed defenders drink through the stores, leaving Daniels struggling to restock.

faq.q: What does he need help with?
faq.answer: Daniels needs travelers to bring fresh liquor from outside Redridge so the inn can keep serving its patrons.

angles.text: For the Alliance, keeping morale high in Lakeshire matters. The settlement is the kingdom's battered buffer against the Blackrock stronghold in the north.
